_doc: Bank salary-transfer offer pages and their T&C documents, watched weekly by the 'salary-transfer' monitor (scripts/monitor/setup.mjs). Like offers, this is a per-BANK surface rather than per-card, which is why it lives here and not on scripts/scrape/banks/<slug>.urls.json. Entries here are alert-only and are never auto-scraped: the salaryTransferOffers collection is entirely typed editor content (salary bands, reward amounts, clawback terms) with no free-text scraper equivalent at all, so a change routes to the business-realestate editor and the deals desk to be typed up against the source. Cadence is weekly rather than daily because salary-transfer promotions move on quarterly campaign cycles; see the credit budget in CLAUDE.md.
_admission_standard: A URL enters `banks` only on evidence, never on plausibility. Either (a) two independent signals — an editor verified it as a live entry's sourceUrl AND discovery independently re-surfaced it — or (b) scripts/monitor/verify-candidates.ts fetched it and returned SUPPORTED. Plausibility is not enough: salaryTransferOfferHistory records that adcb.com/en/personal/promotions/salary-transfer and rakbank.ae/personal/accounts/salary-transfer both returned 404 on re-verification (30 June 2026) despite reading like perfectly ordinary salary-transfer URLs. Candidates that fail stay in _pending with their verdict recorded.

banks._evidence: Owner-supplied 5 August 2026; both fetched same day at HTTP 200. Landing page carries AED amounts, a minimum salary of AED 5,000, a band table and a validity date to 31 December 2026 — SUPPORTED on the verify criteria without a separate run. T&C PDF is the authoritative source and says so explicitly (§6: 'These Terms & Conditions take precedence over any marketing or promotional communication'), so every typed figure in the offer entry derives from it rather than the landing page. Landing page + T&C pair, same shape as the ENBD entry. NOTE: the URL as supplied carried gclid, gbraid and five utm_* parameters; the clean URL was confirmed to resolve on its own and is what is watched here.

Campaign page: live sourceUrl of emirates-nbd-ongoing-2026.mdx, re-surfaced by discovery runs 30982700538 and 30985646889. T&C PDF: verify run 30988856840 returned SUPPORTED (AED 5000, minSalary 5000). Landing page + T&C pair, which is the shape this surface wants. Liv T&C PDF added: SUPPORTED on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026) with the strongest signal set of the whole run — AED 5,000, minimum salary AED 5,000, bands AND clawback, all four. Liv is ENBD's digital bank, so this is likely a distinct offer rather than a duplicate of the campaign above; the desk should confirm which product it describes before either is written up.

NEO page: live sourceUrl of mashreq-2026.mdx, re-surfaced by both discovery runs. Gold page: verify run 30988856840 returned SUPPORTED with the strongest signal set of any candidate (AED 50000, minSalary 25000, band language present). NEO salary-transfer-bonus T&C added: SUPPORTED on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026) (AED 2,500, bands, clawback). This closes a real gap — mashreq-2026.mdx cites a marketing page as its sourceUrl, and the entry can now be re-derived from the terms document, the same upgrade the FAB entry was built with from the start.

Verify run 30988856840 returned SUPPORTED (AED 8000, minSalary 8000). NOTE: this is NOT the dib-xtra-tc.pdf cited by the live dib-xtra-2026.mdx entry, whose bands start at AED 5,000. Two distinct documents both carrying salary-transfer terms — watching this one is safe, but which is current is an editorial question flagged to the business-realestate desk.

SUPPORTED on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026) — minimum salary AED 5,000, band language and clawback wording, three strong signals. Provenance is notable: this URL came from .council/briefs/2026-05-30-salary-transfer-tracker-unverified-figures.md, which recorded it live on 30 May after adcb.com/en/personal/promotions/salary-transfer returned 404. It sat in an open brief for two months while two discovery runs reported 'no candidate found', because the patterns required 'salary' to start a path segment and this slug carries it as a suffix. Replaces the Mar-2017 PDF, which stays in _pending as WEAK.

SUPPORTED on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026) — AED 3,000 and band language. CAVEAT, and it matters for coverage: MBRHE is the Mohammed Bin Rashid Housing Establishment programme, a narrow eligibility segment for UAE nationals, NOT Emirates Islamic's general salary-transfer offer. Watching it is correct; it does not make Emirates Islamic a covered bank in the reader-facing sense. Its general offers page and both 6k/16k T&C documents came back WEAK on the same run — see _pending.

_pending._doc: Candidates fetched or proposed but not yet meeting the admission standard. Verdicts reflect runs 30988856840, 30990596839 and 31003139057. Not watched. A candidate needs two strong signals — AED amount, minimum salary, band language, clawback wording — on a reachable page that mentions salary transfer. NOTE: URL discovery is not the only source of candidates, and 'no candidate found' has twice meant 'discovery did not reach it'. ADCB's live page sat in an open brief for two months; FAB's was supplied by the owner. Both were invisible because the patterns required 'salary' to start a path segment while both slugs carried it as a suffix — fixed 5 August 2026. Check .council/briefs/ before concluding a bank has no offer.

adib.verdict: WEAK (re-verify run 30990596839) — the detector fix worked: this was previously NO SALARY-TRANSFER CONTENT purely because mentionsSalaryTransfer did not know the phrase 'salary bonus'. It is now correctly recognised as salary-transfer content. It still does not qualify: only one strong signal (AED 3,000), where admission needs two. The bands and clawback terms are presumably in a section the scrape did not reach, or in another document. Worth a human look — this is the closest of the remaining candidates to being real.

rakbank.verdict: AWAITING VERIFY on the accounts-lp URL, which comes from .council/briefs/2026-05-30-salary-transfer-tracker-unverified-figures.md (status: open) alongside /rak-more — both recorded live on 30 May 2026 after rakbank.ae/personal/accounts/salary-transfer returned 404. The brief quotes 'up to AED 4,000 cashback on salary transfer'. Previous verdicts (retained): all three discovery paths WEAK across runs 30988856840 and 30990596839 — reachable and on-topic but almost no offer detail, only /rak-more returning a minimum salary of AED 5,000.

standard-chartered.verdict: NO SALARY-TRANSFER CONTENT (unchanged across both runs) — an application form carries little prose. The landing page without /apply is the better watch target and was never proposed by discovery; locate by hand.

adcb.verdict: WEAK (verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026)) — reachable, AED 12,000, no bands or clawback, and dated March 2017. Superseded for monitoring by the switch-nine page now in `banks`; retained only because a 2017 document may still be the terms behind an older cycle.

emirates-islamic.verdict: ALL WEAK on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026), and this reverses what I predicted. I called the 6k/16k T&C documents the most promising candidates in the set; the 6k returned NO signals at all and the 16k only clawback. The general offers page carries AED 6,000 but nothing else. What actually verified was the MBRHE package, which I had dismissed as a narrow segment — now in `banks`. Emirates Islamic's GENERAL offer therefore remains unevidenced, and the bank is not covered in the reader-facing sense. payroll-card retained with its NO SALARY-TRANSFER CONTENT verdict across three runs.

enbd_secondary.verdict: Both WEAK on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026). The /en/promotions/ page returned no signals at all despite the promising slug — a reminder that a good URL is not a good page. The abu-dhabi campaign carries AED 15,000 and nothing else, unchanged across two runs.

_no_candidate.note: No discovery run has found a candidate for these three, including the retry pass with a second search term and the re-run after the 5 August pattern fix. FAB was in this list until 5 August 2026, when the owner supplied a URL discovery could not reach: the anchored patterns required 'salary' to START a path segment, and both FAB's 20-percent-cashback-on-salary-transfers and ADCB's switch-nine-salary-transfer carry it as a slug SUFFIX. Two banks missed on one character. Fixed the same day — discover-salary-transfer.mjs gained a /promotions/.*salary rule and an unanchored salary-transfer fallback ranked last — and the re-run surfaced ADCB's page, which then verified. These three stayed empty through that fix, so their gap is not the same one; treat 'no candidate found' as 'discovery did not reach it' and locate by hand.

mashreq.verdict: UNREACHABLE on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026) — Firecrawl HTTP 502 Bad Gateway. A server error, not a dead page; re-verify before judging it. The Gold tier is a separate product from NEO, so this is worth another attempt.

fab.verdict: WEAK (verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026)) — reachable but AED=0 and no other signal, so the standing account page carries no offer detail of its own. The 20% promotion in `banks` remains the only FAB source worth watching; revisit after it expires 31 December 2026.

dib.verdict: UNREACHABLE on verify run 31003513821 (5 August 2026) — Firecrawl HTTP 408 Request Timeout, the second transient failure on a DIB PDF this session. Re-verify. It may help settle the source conflict in the 2026-08-05 brief.
